name: AsahiKasei KARAKSA-F PA-CNF DX @U1 0.4 nozzle
filament_notes: Asahi Kasei KARAKSA-F PA-CNF DX (DX205) is cellulose-nanofiber reinforced polyamide, not carbon-fiber PA. Use the PA material category. U1 0.4 mm starting profile: nozzle 275 C (manufacturer range 260-280 C), PEI/hot/engineering bed 65 C (DX maximum), flow ratio 0.96, maximum volumetric speed 12 mm3/s. The flow ratio and volumetric limit are carried over from the user's QIDI MAX4 profile at the user's request; they are not U1 measurements or manufacturer-certified flow limits. U1 physical print validation is pending. Dry the filament and use PA-compatible bed adhesive. Retains U1 Generic PA tool-change behavior and high-temperature classification. Standard-flow profile only; other nozzle sizes and high-flow configurations require separate calibration. Manufacturer: https://www.asahi-kasei.co.jp/karaksa/products/pa-filament.html DX205 TDS: https://filament2print.com/en/index.php?controller=attachment&id_attachment=3734
